original_test_intent: Read one known event from the selected BMC Event Message Buffer, validate the complete SEL-format event payload and the mandated buffer-full flag transition, while proving the persistent SEL and all unrelated evidence remain untouched.
original_method: The Master supplies no method. Standard Read Event Message Buffer 0x06/0x35 with no request data is a candidate only after a controlled event or explicit empty-buffer branch is defined and the owning consumer authorizes the state-changing read.
manual_activity: Engineer coordinates the Event Message Buffer consumer, approves one event-producing stimulus or empty-buffer check, and judges whether the decoded record and full-flag behavior match the platform contract.
required_inputs: Verified BMC and Event Message Buffer ownership
Pre-read Message Flags and Global Enables
Approved deterministic event stimulus or empty-buffer scenario
Explicit one-read authorization and sensitive-event redaction policy
safety_requirements: Never clear SEL, dmesg or syslog
Preserve Message Flags and SEL correlation before reading
Do not read a shared buffer without owner coordination
Issue 0x06/0x35 at most once per approval
Treat the read as consuming volatile evidence and clearing the full indication
Reject malformed or non-16-byte success payloads
Do not generate a replacement event or reset the BMC automatically
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, buffer owner and enable state
Capture raw pre-read Message Flags and persistent SEL context
Confirm the expected event or empty branch
Validate completion and decode the complete 16-byte record
Capture post-read Message Flags and unchanged persistent SEL
Report any unexpected event without further reads
engineer_actions: Approve stimulus and consumption of the buffered event
Investigate malformed, unexpected or security-sensitive events

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek supplies no command because the source is TBD. The standard read is identifiable, but running it without a known event and owner would alter the very state needed for later diagnosis.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After preserving flags/SEL and obtaining one-read approval, issue exactly one `ipmitool ... raw 0x06 0x35`, handle the defined empty completion or require a complete 16-byte event, then stop.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master TBD procedure/criteria and 10/5 timing remain unchanged; no event type, record value or retry is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an event-aware recorder that binds stimulus time, pre-flags, one read, raw 16-byte payload, decoded SEL fields, post-flags and persistent-SEL correlation in one immutable transaction.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines a controlled functional oracle and the buffer-full side-effect audit for an otherwise empty Master procedure.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An approved empty-buffer result covers no-data handling only; it does not demonstrate event delivery or SEL-format decoding. Reading SEL records does not substitute for this volatile buffer path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The buffer may be overwritten or consumed by another management client between stimulus and read. After the command clears/advances volatile state, the original precondition cannot be reconstructed exactly.

project_override_considerations: A vendor event-buffer API is equivalent only when it exposes the same volatile entry, full-flag side effect and raw 16-byte record. A persistent SEL viewer or log export is supporting evidence, not replacement coverage.
expected_evidence: BMC/buffer owner, Global Enables and raw pre-read Message Flags
Approved event stimulus identity/timestamp or explicit empty branch
Single raw 0x06/0x35 request/response and completion handling
Exactly 16 raw bytes on success with decoded record ID/type, timestamp/generator, sensor and event data as applicable
Post-read Message Flags showing the defined full-indication transition
Persistent SEL/log evidence proving no repository clear
Consumption audit and owner disposition of unexpected content

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source body and criteria are absent rather than conflicting. The title names a standard buffer operation whose event and acceptance remain project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation, state effect and evidence format can be defined. Execution waits for buffer ownership, stimulus or empty branch, parser and approval; these gaps do not prevent static review.

review_improvement: Turns the TBD row into a one-transaction event-buffer contract that explicitly audits the full-flag side effect, distinguishes volatile buffer data from persistent SEL and prevents polling from destroying diagnostic evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: This command is nominally a read but changes the observable buffer condition, so pre-state and post-state are both part of the result. A 16-byte record without a matched stimulus might be stale or owned by another consumer, while an empty completion after another reader raced the test is not proof of correct behavior. Atomic stimulus correlation and a single authorized read are therefore essential.
